correctness.rationale: A product ideal whose proper-coordinate set is S is a vertex exactly for nonempty proper S; a proper local ideal is contained in the local radical, and two proper ideals in one local factor cannot sum to the factor. This proves the six-class structure directly. Two white vertices in a class are inseparable. With lambda_3 > 1, blue sources in L_1 and L_2 clear C_1 and C_2; if L_3 is a white singleton, a blue vertex in C_3 forces it before L_3 clears C_3. All other leaf whites can then be forced. The quotient has block form [A I; I 0], determinant -1; the incidence lift has rank six and M <= Z gives equality. In the six positive root magnitudes all pair products are >= the second smallest local ideal count, so the first two order statistics yield the two smallest counts including ties; the product gives the cube of the full local-count product. Counting proper powers in a chain ring includes the zero ideal, yielding the stated lengths. Independent replay: python /workspace/audit_checks.py 5 uses coordinatewise ideal sums and exhaustive vertex masks. It obtains (N,Z,minimizers) = (9,3,8), (13,7,64), (18,12,512) and validates every coefficient and complement profile. The excluded all-field graph has 9u^2+20u^3+15u^4+6u^5+u^6. These are finite checks, not the general proof.
